description: The plot titled “Hidden State Mean” illustrates the absolute mean of hidden states across model layers, comparing three quantities: the hidden state mean before the gate (dashed blue line), the hidden state mean after the gate (dotted orange line), and the raw hidden state (solid green line). The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to approximately 23 with linear spacing and integer tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Abs Mean,” ranges from 0 to 4.5, also on a linear scale, with major ticks at 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4. The dashed blue line, representing the hidden state mean before the gate, starts near 0.1 at layer 0, remains relatively flat until layer 10, then gradually increases to about 0.9 by layer 20, and sharply rises to over 4 by layer 22. The dotted orange line, representing the hidden state mean after the gate, remains near zero across all layers, with an average value of 0.05 as noted in the legend. The solid green line, representing the raw hidden state, stays close to zero throughout all layers, with a slight upward trend near the end, reaching approximately 0.1 at layer 22. The legend also notes that the average hidden state mean before the gate is 0.71.
